meta.project: Viking Strategy Game — Tactical Raid Layer Refactor
meta.goal: Units move smoothly in continuous space using NavigationServer2D. Nothing currently working breaks. SettlementNavigationManager (AStarGrid2D) is never touched.
meta.critical_rule: DO NOT touch NavigationManager.gd, SettlementManager.gd, or any autoload not listed in affected_files. After every step, verify settlement building placement still works.

existing_navigation.action: DO NOT TOUCH. Remains as SettlementNavigationManager in all but name.

existing_unit_movement.current_behaviour: MOVING and FORMATION_MOVING states call NavigationManager.get_astar_path() and follow the returned PackedVector2Array step by step.
existing_unit_movement.action: Modify MOVING and FORMATION_MOVING only. All other states untouched.

existing_unit_spawner.current_behaviour: Calls NavigationManager.request_valid_spawn_point() to validate spawn positions during raids.
existing_unit_spawner.action: Add raid context check. During raids call RaidNavigationManager. During settlement use existing NavigationManager call unchanged.

existing_raid_scene.action: Add NavigationRegion2D as child of RaidMission root.

existing_unit_scene.action: Add NavigationAgent2D as child of CharacterBody2D.

steps.title: Create RaidNavigationManager.gd
steps.description: New autoload that wraps NavigationServer2D for use during raids only. Does not interact with NavigationManager.gd at all.

initialize_raid_map.description: Called when a raid scene loads. Gets the NavigationServer map RID from the NavigationRegion2D in the scene.

request_valid_spawn_point.description: Finds a valid spawn position near a target using NavigationServer2D. Replaces NavigationManager.request_valid_spawn_point() during raids.

get_next_path_position.description: Not used directly — NavigationAgent2D handles path following per unit. This is a utility for debug purposes.

steps.verify: Autoload appears in Godot project settings. No errors on launch.

steps.title: Add NavigationRegion2D to RaidMission.tscn
steps.description: Add a NavigationRegion2D node as a child of the RaidMission root. This defines the walkable area for NavigationServer2D. The navmesh polygon will be set programmatically by RaidMapLoader based on map dimensions.

properties.navigation_polygon: Leave empty — set at runtime by RaidMapLoader

script_changes.description: In the existing _ready() or map loading function, after terrain is generated, call RaidNavigationManager.initialize_raid_map() and bake the navmesh.

steps.before_writing: Confirm the exact function name in RaidMission.gd where map_loader.load_base() is called, so the navigation init fires after terrain exists.
steps.verify: RaidNavRegion node visible in scene tree. No navigation errors on raid scene load.

steps.title: Add NavigationAgent2D to Base_Unit.tscn
steps.description: Add NavigationAgent2D as a child of the CharacterBody2D root in Base_Unit.tscn. All unit subclasses inherit this automatically.

script_changes.description: Add NavAgent reference and helper functions. Do not modify existing movement logic yet — that happens in Step 4.
add_functions: # Settlement movement unchanged — UnitFSM still uses AStarGrid2D outside raids

steps.verify: NavAgent node visible on all unit scenes. No errors on unit instantiation.

steps.title: Update UnitFSM MOVING States
steps.action: MODIFY — MOVING AND FORMATION_MOVING STATES ONLY
steps.description: Update the MOVING and FORMATION_MOVING states to use NavigationAgent2D during raids. Outside raids, behaviour is completely unchanged.
steps.critical_rule: Wrap ALL new navigation code in: if RaidNavigationManager.is_raid_active. The AStarGrid2D path following must remain intact for the else branch.

MOVING_state.description: Replace direct path array following with NavigationAgent2D target setting during raids.

FORMATION_MOVING_state.description: Squad leader uses NavigationAgent2D to reach formation target during raids. Soldiers continue rubber-banding to formation_target as before — formation_target is a world position, not a nav path, so soldiers need no change.
before: # Current: leader follows AStarGrid2D path to formation slot

steps.before_writing: Confirm exact variable names used in current MOVING state for path array and current step index, so the else branch preserves them correctly.
steps.verify: Units move smoothly to clicked positions during raid. No zig-zag motion. Settlement unit movement unchanged.

steps.title: Update UnitSpawner Raid Spawn Validation
steps.description: During raids, use RaidNavigationManager.request_valid_spawn_point() instead of NavigationManager.request_valid_spawn_point(). Outside raids, use existing logic unchanged.
steps.critical_rule: Only the spawn point validation function call changes. All other UnitSpawner logic is untouched.

after: # Use closest as spawn position directly

steps.before_writing: Show the full body of _spawn_unit_core and _spawn_civilians so spawn validation calls can be located precisely before modification.
steps.verify: Units spawn correctly during raid. Settlement unit spawning unchanged. No spawn-in-wall errors.

phase_completion_test.description: Run this manual test after all 5 steps are complete before proceeding to Phase 2.

steps: Confirm no navigation errors in output
tests.pass_condition: Building placement works identically to before refactor

steps: Confirm smooth continuous movement (no grid snapping)
tests.pass_condition: Units move smoothly with no zig-zag. No AStarGrid2D errors.
Formation maintains shape during movement. Rubber-banding still functions.

steps: Confirm player units spawn at beach
Confirm no units spawn inside buildings or off navmesh
tests.pass_condition: All units spawn at valid positions.
